name: legion-hermes-mode
description: The routing guide for a Hermes-primary Legion session. Hermes can work inline as a registered coding family and use a metered, isolated `legion-delegate run --executor <different-harness>` handoff for independent implementation, review, and tie-breaks. Triggers when Hermes or one of its cron jobs / skills needs to build, fix, test, review, or delegate code work.
